# enterprise-agent-control-plane

> Runnable reference architecture for governed enterprise tool-using agents:
> bounded context, policy gates, audit traces. It builds one Customer
> Operations agent two ways — an unsafe baseline vs a bounded, policy-gated,
> auditable control plane — and runs the contrast offline.

This is a reference architecture and learning repository, **not** production
security software and not a hardening guide. All tools and data are synthetic.

## Audience

Platform and engineering teams, security teams, AI/data leaders, and
consultants evaluating governance patterns for tool-using agents.

## Architecture

- Unsafe baseline: full tool catalog every step, raw outputs forwarded into
  context, write/destructive actions with no policy gate, flat free-text logs.
- Governed control plane: bounded capability shortlist, deterministic flows,
  capability tokens, allow/deny/ask policy gate, bounded output frame, and a
  structured audit trace.
- The demo runs both on the same scenario and prints a side-by-side contrast.

## dgenio ecosystem mapping (patterns demonstrated locally)

- contextweaver — bounded shortlist / context firewall (`catalog.py`)
- ChainWeaver — deterministic flow executor (`flows.py`)
- agent-kernel — capability tokens / authorization (`policies.py`, governed path)
- AgentFence — allow/deny/ask policy gate (`policies.py`)
- skdr-eval — offline evaluation lane (`evals.py`, `evals/`)
- lessonweaver — reviewed lessons (`lessons.py`)
- VibeGuard — CI guardrails for AI-generated changes (`.github/workflows/vibeguard.yml`)

## Commands

- `make setup` — install the package (editable, only dependency is pydantic).
- `make demo` — run the baseline-vs-governed demo offline.
- `make test` — run the unit test suite (`unittest`).

## Key paths

- `enterprise_agent_control_plane/` — the package (baseline + governed agents).
- `apps/demo_cli/main.py` — the runnable demo entry point.
- `flows/` — flow definitions. `policies/` — policy definitions.
- `evals/` — offline evaluation data. `traces/` — emitted run artifacts.
- `demos/` — inert illustrative fixtures. `docs/` — documentation.

## Limitations

No production-readiness or security guarantees. The model is replaced by a
deterministic offline router for reproducibility; the governed-side libraries
above are demonstrated as local patterns, not consumed as live dependencies.
